subject: FREE statement
notes: GR1 a) release + set NULL when the pointer identifies the START of currently ALLOCATEd storage; b) NULL -> no action; c) otherwise EC-STORAGE-NOT-ALLOC (cite.py --check 14.9.15.4 a) and c) -> OK; Table EC-STORAGE-NOT-ALLOC is NF). CobolPtr.Free: null/IsNull -> Null (b); CellPointer{Offset:0, Cell{Allocated:true,Freed:false}} -> mark Freed, clear image+slots, return Null (a; 'contents become undefined' realized as a loud deref); else notAlloc=true, operand unchanged (c). EmitFree raises EC-STORAGE-NOT-ALLOC nonfatal only when checking is enabled (14.6.13.1.4 - unchecked nonfatal continues). Probes f1 (>>TURN EC-STORAGE-NOT-ALLOC CHECKING ON + USE declarative): FREE of NULL N -> no EC; FREE of R = P UP BY 1 (not start) -> EC, R unchanged; FREE P Q (Q an alias of already-freed P) -> P NULL, Q gets EC (no longer 'currently allocated'); FREE of SET P TO ADDRESS OF W (WORKING-STORAGE, not ALLOCATEd) -> EC, P unchanged; f3 checking off -> no EC, EXCEPTION-STATUS blank. All three arms verified. Only arm a) has a golden (conformance:cases/14.9.3-ALLOCATE/pointer_alloc, FREED=YES); arms b)/c) have none -> test-ref empty. || editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (FREE is absent from ISO 1989:1985; the 2023 Annex E records only 2014->2023 changes, and 14.9.15 is unchanged text in 2014/2023) retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/Procedure/Verbs/EcBinder.cs#EC-STORAGE-NOT-ALLOC (the BoundFree row moved into EcBinder.RaiseDeclarations.cs (kb/Work PB3102))
